name: game-design-suite
description: Professional game design suite covering systems, gameplay, combat, skills, balance, formula verification, simulation, telemetry experiments, meta balance, economy, progression, level design, UX, configuration auditing, code verification, design review, and GDD workflows. Every independent formal result uses a visible Professional Context Header by default.

interface.shortDescription: Professional game design, numerical simulation, telemetry, and balance workflows
interface.longDescription: A multi-skill suite for gameplay and systems design, whole-project numerical architecture, combat and skill design, numerical balancing, formula reconstruction and verification, Monte Carlo and discrete-event simulation, telemetry and experiments, meta/roster balance, economy and progression, level design, game UX, configuration auditing, code verification, design review, and formal GDD production. Professional routing is exposed with a mandatory per-result Professional Context Header, including a first-visible-line gate and pre-send header lint.
defaultPrompt: Design a whole-project numerical architecture from experience targets through combat, progression, economy, and content difficulty.
Analyze this game system and propose a production-ready design.
Review this hero skill, its balance, configuration, and implementation.
Verify this combat formula against configuration, code, and reference models.
Simulate this build 1000 times and report the distribution, tail risk, and sensitive parameters.
Design telemetry and an experiment to validate whether this balance change works.
Audit this roster and composition meta for dominance, pair locks, and power creep.
